name: Triesha Miller
text: I can’t say enough good things about Mike and the electrical work he did. He was professional, knowledgeable, dependable, and took the time to make sure everything was done correctly. His attention to detail was excellent, and it was clear that he takes a lot of pride in the quality of his work. I would absolutely call Mike again for any future electrical needs. If you’re looking for an electrician you can trust to do the job right, I highly recommend Mike! Five stars all the way!

name: Ron Gonzalez
text: I couldn’t be happier with the work done by Michael Berryhill and his crew. They completely remodeled two bathrooms and did an excellent job transforming a previously unused closet into a dedicated space for a side-by-side washer and dryer. From start to finish, the workmanship was excellent, the attention to detail was impressive, and everything was completed professionally. They also handled all of the necessary city permits, which made the entire process much easier and less stressful for me. The quality of the work exceeded my expectations, and the finished projects look fantastic. If you’re looking for a reliable, skilled, and professional contractor who takes pride in their work, I highly recommend them. I would definitely use them again for future projects!

name: Carla Howard
text: Mike was a major help with electrical work when we were updating our late parents' home for sale. He perfectly replaced florescent fixtures with recessed can lights in the kitchen and baths, updated the switches throughout, replaced the inefficient bath fans. Overall, he was great to work with as well as prompt and professional at all times. We highly recommend him!

name: DEBORAH Steele
text: MB Construction was very professional, on time and did exactly what he said the job would entail. I would hire him again, actually I’ve already referred his company to a friend.

name: Ann Sacks
text: For over forty years I have worked with contractors around the country in my role as the founder of tile and stone companies. At the same time I was involved in the development of real estate projects in Portland ranging from homes to small hotels. Recently my husband and I purchased a home in Palm Springs and added an addition with the help of Michael Berryhill. In collaboration with our architect in Portland Michael executed a gem that far exceeded our expectations. The new house is integrated so beautifully that you cannot tell where the original ends and the new space begins. On time and on budget, with very little oversight from us, Michael created something that functions perfectly and looks fantastic. I highly recommend him for his hard work, independence, problem solving, and integrity. -Ann Sacks

name: Robert Sacks
text: We added an addition to our mid century home in Palm Springs. Michael was fantastic. The addition looks indistinguishable from the rest of the home, which was the goal. Michael’s work was first rate and was on time and within budget. I would highly recommend him and his company for any construction project. I am in construction in Portland and have an excellent idea of how the business works. Robert Sacks

name: David Cleary
text: Michael was an excellent communicator (the best I've experienced in a GC) whether by phone, text or email. He sent photos as work progressed and regularly asked for feedback. He's punctual and gets things done when he says he will. He's resourceful and knows where to source things or which sub to call: even the busiest folks pick up the phone for Michael Berryhill.

name: jody wood
text: Michael can do it all and very well!

name: N S
text: I highly recommend Michael with MB Construction! Michael and his crew demonstrated exceptional skill, efficiency, and professionalism throughout our project of adding a casita to our home. The quality of work exceeded our expectations, and Michael was always willing to go the extra mile and he completed the job on time. Excellent communication and attention to detail.
